title: Union membership fees on top of the allowance (from 2026)
summary: From 2026, payments of union membership fees that qualify as Werbungskosten (§ 9 Abs. 1 Satz 3 Nr. 3 EStG) are taken into account in addition to the Arbeitnehmer-Pauschbetrag.
conditions: Applies from the 2026 tax year (law in force 1 January 2026)
notes: Art. 2 Nr. 4 and Art. 12 Abs. 2 of the Steueränderungsgesetz 2025.
